ns2:course.label: Individual Study
ns2:course.description: Individual study in a subject not covered in course offerings may be arranged for credit by registration under this number. 2 to 16 hours for full term; 1 to 8 hours for half-term. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
